remainingLimits: Single prepared specimen, with no independently established patient laterality/orientation or HU calibration.
Registered voxel spacing does not establish effective spatial resolution.
Microscopy contributes to masks; their CBCT overlay does not prove CBCT detectability. This reader does not supply micro-slicing images or close every soft-tissue image requirement.
Source positive-cell distances and sampled geometry correspondence are not clinical boundary accuracy or patient registration validation.
Original author surfaces may differ from cropped masks and small components; no unsupported photographic texture is applied.
Review is targeted source/header/mesh sampling plus adverse lifecycle checks and code review, not a duplicate full-volume scan or whole-Primer completion audit.
